params.name: fontFamily
params.description: Name of the font family for which to get supported styles and names (see FONT LIST to get the list of font families)

params.name: fontStyleList
params.description: Filled with the localized style names supported by fontFamily

params.name: fontNameList
params.description: Filled with the complete, non-localized font names supported by fontFamily, synchronized element-by-element with fontStyleList

overloads.semanticRole: Returns, for a given font family, the parallel lists of supported (localized) style names and their corresponding (non-localized) complete font names.

constraints: fontStyleList returns localized style names (e.g. "Italic" appears as "Itálico" on a Spanish system), suitable for a localized "Style" pop-up menu.

fontNameList returns non-localized, system-identification-based font names intended for use with the wk font 4D Write Pro attribute of WP SET ATTRIBUTES, so stored documents remain portable across system languages.
If fontFamily is not found on the machine, both arrays are returned empty.
